meaning.text: Integration binding ProviderCatalog, structurally derived from its Alch declaration.
Filter enabled tenant-permitted task bindings by explicit alias, streaming and token limits.

clauses.text: where row.enabled and row.tenant_allowed and row.task == input.request.task and row.model == coalesce(input.request.model, row.model) and (not input.request.stream or row.streaming) and row.context_limit >= input.request.required_context_tokens and row.output_limit >= input.request.max_output_tokens
